weave.text: It starts the night before. {s_eve}. The house hums, the lights blink, and somebody is always still wrapping at midnight.
Every family has the thing it does every year without question. For {who}, it is this: {tradition|low}. Outsiders may laugh. Insiders would never dream of skipping it.
When the boxes come down from the loft, one decoration always gets held a little longer. {s_bauble}. It is not the prettiest thing on the tree. It is the most loved.
Dinner is a serious business. {dinner}. Diplomacy has been attempted. Diplomacy has failed.
As for the naughty list, the evidence is in. {naughty}. The jury is unanimous, and slightly jealous.
And behind all of it, someone is quietly holding the whole thing together. {s_hero}. Christmas does not just happen. Somebody makes it happen, out of love.
If this year could be wrapped up and kept, it would be this moment. {moment}.

weave.text: The big news first, because it could not wait. {headline}. Reporters at the scene describe the mood as delighted, loud and missing you.
There is an empty chair at the table that nobody ever quite gets used to. What everyone misses most is {miss|low}. Distance is long. Love is longer.
Overheard in the kitchen this week: {quote|low}. The family stands by every word.
Some memories live in your nose. Ask anyone and they will tell you that the house smells of {s_house|low}. It is the smell of being safe and fed and loved.
The lesson that stuck? {s_taught}. It gets passed on now, at every meal, to people who were not even born when it was first said.
And when the day comes, the plan is already made. {s_visit}. Then probably more of the same.

weave.text: Meet {first}, aged {age} and already the leading expert in {expert|low}. Ask a question. You will get an answer, and then about forty more.
{first} has a language all of their own. {s_says}. Nobody in the house is ever going to correct it. Some words are too perfect to fix.
There is a story the grown ups tell whenever they need cheering up. {fact}. Big imagination, bigger heart.
And then there is the moment that made everyone's eyes go a bit watery. {s_kind}. Nobody told {first} to do it. That is just who {first} is.
Want to hear the best sound in the world? Try {s_laugh|low}. Guaranteed giggles, every single time.
When {first} grows up, the plan is to be {dream|low}. We believe it completely.

weave.text: If you had to sum up {year} in a single word, {from} would choose {word|low}. Read on and you will see why.
The big one was {adventure|low}. Things went wrong. Everyone was there. It was perfect.
There were firsts, too. {s_firsts}. Small steps, big cheers.
And the proudest moment of all? {proud}. Hearts were full. Phones were out. Some tears may have happened.
But ask what they will really remember and it is something quieter. {s_ordinary}. The best days rarely make the calendar.
What did the year teach them? {s_learned}. Not a bad thing to carry into next year.

weave.text: Walk through the door and you will understand immediately. {s_hello}. Nobody else on earth is that pleased to see you, every single time.
{first} has gifts. Some might call them ridiculous. We call them talent. {talent}.
Of course, there is a criminal record. {crime}. All charges have been dropped in exchange for cuddles.
Naps are taken seriously and always in the same place: {s_nap|low}. Do not even think about it.
The moment that made {first} a family legend? {moment}. It gets told at every gathering. It gets better every time.
And the quiet truth is that {first} has taught {from} more than any book. {s_taught}.

weave.text: On {born} the universe got a little brighter. {first} arrived, a true {sign}, and the stars have been showing off ever since.
Every sign has a gift. {first}'s is this: {power|low}. Astronomers cannot explain it. Friends simply enjoy it.
They shine brightest like this: {s_shine|low}. If you have seen it, you know. If you have not, you are missing out.
Gravity is a funny thing. {first} pulls everyone in. {s_orbit}. Nobody ever really wants to leave.
On a shooting star, {first} would wish for {s_wish|low}. The universe has been informed.
And the forecast for the year ahead? {prediction}. The stars are rarely wrong.

weave.text: On {born}, at {weight}, the whole world changed shape. {first} arrived, and nothing has been the same since. Nothing has been better, either.
The name was chosen with so much care. {s_name}. It suits {first} perfectly already.
The first night at home went exactly as you would expect. {s_home}. Nobody would change a second of it.
The family debate is ongoing. Who does {first} look like? The official answer is {looks|low}. The unofficial answer is the most beautiful baby who ever lived.
{first} already has opinions. Top of the list are {loves|low}. Bottom of the list is being put down.
And the dream, the big one, is simple. {s_dream}.

weave.text: A year ago, {first} arrived. These days most people call them {nick}, and it fits like a tiny, perfect sock.
The first word was {word|low}. The family is still recovering from the pride.
This year was full of firsts, but one stands out. {s_first}. Grown adults cried.
If you want the best sound in the house, try {s_laugh|low}. Instant giggles. Every time.
And when it is time to settle, there is only one thing that works. {s_song}.
Food reviews have been mixed. The worst score of the year went to {food|low}. The face said everything.

weave.text: It began {years} years ago. {s_start}. Nobody could have guessed what a mark {first} would leave.
Ask around and you will hear it straight away. {first} is famous for {known|low}. Legends are made of less.
There was always a saying, usually at exactly the right moment. {s_saying}. People will be repeating it for years.
The lesson everyone will keep? {s_taught}.
The place will feel different on Monday. What everyone will miss most is {miss|low}. Some people are not easily replaced. Some people simply cannot be.
As for what comes next: {plans|low}. They have earned every minute of it.
